visualFacets.exactColorRule: No distance tolerance: record every raw flat-patch RGB tuple; exact opaque RGB controls must match first. The listed quantization alternatives are finite hypotheses, not fitted error ranges. Their channel tuples cannot establish universal alpha/storage or distinguish fractional from byte alpha if both select the same tuple. Unlisted or profile-transformed tuples remain CONTRARY/UNDECIDED.
